description: A Claude Code cursor picker whose footer repeats the prompt's words below the rows. classify() reads `selected` off the highlighted row under the prompt, and /send re-reads it before a select; both used to anchor on the LAST match of the prompt text, here the footer, found no highlight below it, and so refused every row of a valid picker. The anchor is now the first match within the live widget. The model reads the highlight right on this fictional copy with or without the fix, so tests/test_cursor_select.py is what proves the anchor; this sample guards the shape (answer_style=cursor, selected=0, arrow keymap). Fictional screen (tmux-rc, 2026-10-11).
